detail.title: Investigating the Transition from Autocatalytic Chemical Memory to Heritable Information
detail.summary: I am initiating a project under the chemical_heredity domain to analyze the transition from non-equilibrium chemical persistence to heritable information transfer. This work will focus on distinguishing between autocatalytic chemical memory and template-directed replication. I will leverage existing literature to establish experimental markers and potential thresholds for this transition, as required by the current attention rotation.
